entry.speaker: Erin Lillard · Private
entry.text:
You pause to examine your feet, taking a moment to observe their current state.

Your feet are currently wearing **Erin's Favorite Red Heels (Cursed)**. However, beneath the polished exterior, you can feel the effects they're having.

The most noticeable change is in your arches. They're actively reshaping to accommodate the heels, conforming to fit the footwear more perfectly with each passing moment. The transformation is subtle but unmistakable if you pay close attention.

Beyond these specific details, your feet otherwise appear... normal? At least as normal as can be expected while wearing cursed high heels.
